= Task query

.Due soon
[.weftext-query,version=1,view=task-list]
....
from tasks as task
scope workspace
where not task.closed = true
  and (task.due is null or task.due <= context.today + P14D)
  and task.priority in ["highest", "high", "normal"]
group by task.state as group_state
select task.kind, task.id as task_id, task.owner_node.id as owner_node_id, task.title, task.closed, task.state, task.priority, task.due
order by task.due asc nulls last, task.priority desc
limit 250
....
